title: Grimms Märchen
author: Jacob und Wilhelm Grimm
desc: 22 tales from the Kinder- und Hausmärchen (7th edition, 1857), shortest first. Old spelling: Thür, rothem, daß.

title: Der Struwwelpeter
author: Heinrich Hoffmann
desc: Funny, gruesome cautionary tales in rhyme: Zappel-Philipp, Suppen-Kaspar, Hans Guck-in-die-Luft.

title: Max und Moritz
author: Wilhelm Busch
desc: Seven pranks by two naughty boys, told in rhyming couplets.

title: Kalendergeschichten
author: Johann Peter Hebel
desc: Short stories from the Schatzkästlein des rheinischen Hausfreundes, starting with Kannitverstan.

title: Die Geschichte von dem kleinen Muck
author: Wilhelm Hauff
desc: The little man with the magic slippers and the walking stick that finds gold.
